name: Twixl
description_en:
Twixl is a publishing platform for branded content apps on mobile and in the browser. It accepts material such as HTML, InDesign exports, PDFs and media, then organizes it into an app’s navigation and collections. It is particularly relevant when content production and reader access are more central than custom application logic.

Its workflow separates online content management, device preview and production builds through a macOS application. Reader subscriptions are separate from the publisher’s Twixl license. Evaluate the content lifecycle, account ownership and access model together before selecting a plan.
description_zh:
Twixl 是面向移动和浏览器品牌内容应用的发布平台，可接收 HTML、InDesign 导出、PDF 及媒体，再组织成导航和内容集合。适合内容生产与读者访问比自定义应用逻辑更核心的场景。

流程区分在线内容管理、设备预览及通过 macOS 应用进行正式构建。读者订阅不同于发布者的 Twixl 许可，选择方案前应一起评估内容生命周期、账户归属及访问模型。

core_features.explanation_en: Collections group uploaded content items; Root Collection and Sidebar shape initial navigation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 集合组织上传的内容项，Root Collection 和 Sidebar 定义初始导航。

core_features.explanation_en: Standard covers content added during a subscription period; All Access covers the catalog while valid.
core_features.explanation_zh: Standard 覆盖订阅期间新增内容，All Access 在有效期内开放整个内容库。

en: Evaluate a branded publication with both PDF and HTML content.
Check archive access for Standard and All Access reader subscriptions.
zh: 评估同时含 PDF 与 HTML 的品牌出版应用。
检查 Standard 与 All Access 读者订阅的存档访问。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Create a synthetic collection and preview its navigation and content on target devices.
steps.zh: 建立模拟集合，在目标设备预览导航及内容。

steps.en: Confirm publisher plan, Mac/build access and store product mapping; test subscription access before production distribution.
steps.zh: 核对发布者方案、Mac／构建权限及商店产品映射，正式分发前测试订阅访问。

items.en: Device preview does not replace the production app/build requirement.
items.zh: 设备预览不能替代正式应用及构建要求。

items.en: Custom entitlement and integration capabilities have plan/service boundaries.
items.zh: 自定义 entitlement 及集成能力存在方案／服务边界。

pricing.summary_en: Twixl Publisher offers yearly Essential, Professional and Enterprise licensing, with separate app-count and optional-service limits. The read page’s flattened amount row could not be mapped reliably to every plan, so no monthly normalization or definitive plan amount is assigned. Reader purchases/subscriptions are separate.
pricing.summary_zh: Twixl Publisher 提供 Essential、Professional、Enterprise 年度许可，应用数量和可选服务另有限制。已读页扁平化金额行无法可靠对应每个方案，因此未标准化月价或指定确定方案金额。读者购买／订阅另行处理。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.en: The platform distinguishes individual content items from collections. Root Collection is the entry point, while other collections can link to one another without a strict hierarchy. Create a small sample with two content types and verify how each item appears under the selected grid/item styles.
sections.zh: 平台区分单个内容项和集合。Root Collection 为入口，其他集合之间可互相链接而不必形成严格层级。应使用两种内容类型建立小样，检查其在所选网格／项目样式中的呈现。

sections.title_en: Preview and production builds are different stages
sections.en: The Twixl mobile app previews a project through its QR code. Building a real iOS/Android app uses Twixl’s macOS application and requires a production app with an active subscription. Check Mac access and release ownership before assuming that an online preview is a store-ready binary.
sections.zh: Twixl 移动应用通过项目二维码预览。真实 iOS／Android 构建使用 Twixl macOS 应用，并要求有有效订阅的 production app。应先确认 Mac 和发布账户归属，不能将在线预览视为可直接提交商店的二进制文件。

sections.title_zh: 选择读者订阅访问语义
sections.en: Standard subscriptions grant access to new collections or PDF issues added during the subscribed period; All Access grants the whole app catalog while valid. New Standard subscribers also receive the latest paid collection/PDF. Test old, current and expired subscribers against the intended archive policy.
sections.zh: Standard 订阅开放订阅期间新增集合或 PDF 期刊，All Access 在有效期内开放整个应用内容库。Standard 新订阅者还会获得最近发布的付费集合／PDF。应按目标存档政策测试旧、当前及到期订阅者。

sections.en: The guide requires the same product identifier and duration on the Twixl platform and store configuration. Its iOS path also uses an app-specific shared secret. Verify these mappings with test purchases before offering paid access; a configured paywall alone does not prove purchase validation works.
sections.zh: 指南要求 Twixl 平台与商店配置使用相同产品标识及期限，iOS 路径还使用应用专属 shared secret。开放付费访问前应通过测试购买核对映射，配置付费墙本身不能证明购买验证正常。

sections.en: The product page distinguishes manual upload, CMS push and RSS-based pull. Test updates and media with the chosen source rather than assuming all content can follow one route. Plan edition identifiers and navigation links before importing a real archive, and separately verify recovery if a source pushes an incorrect update.
sections.zh: 产品页区分手动上传、CMS 推送及 RSS 拉取。应按所选来源测试更新与媒体，不能假定全部内容走同一路径。导入真实存档前应规划版本标识及导航链接，并单独核对错误推送后的恢复方法。

sections.title_en: Keep publisher licensing separate from reader sales
sections.title_zh: 区分发布者许可与读者销售
sections.en: The annual comparison lists Essential with one production app and Professional/Enterprise with one or more. Custom entitlement and custom CMS integration require Professional/Enterprise; some services remain optional. Reader in-app subscriptions do not replace this publisher license. Obtain a quote that identifies app count, integrations and services.
sections.zh: 年付对照表列 Essential 一个正式应用，Professional／Enterprise 一个或多个。自定义 entitlement 和自定义 CMS 集成要求 Professional／Enterprise，部分服务仍为可选项。读者应用内订阅不能替代发布者许可，应取得注明应用数、集成及服务的报价。
